items.raw_excerpt: Longe das rotas mais movimentadas do Alentejo, há uma mesa que os conhecedores fazem questão de recomendar. E basta provar um dos pratos da casa para perceber o motivo.
items.summary_en: Away from the busiest routes in Alentejo, there is a table that food lovers always recommend. Tasting one of the house dishes is enough to understand why. It is a must-stop if you want to eat well in Alentejo.
items.summary_ko: 알렌테주의 가장 붐비는 길을 벗어난 곳에 미식가들이 꼭 추천하는 식당이 있다. 이 집 대표 요리 하나만 맛봐도 그 이유를 알게 된다. 알렌테주에서 제대로 먹고 싶다면 꼭 들러야 할 곳이다.
items.title_en: A must-stop table in Alentejo for good food

items.raw_excerpt: The homegrown Chinese restaurant group, which now has 13 outlets in Singapore, says the closures are part of an ongoing review of its operations.
items.summary_en: Crystal Jade, a local Chinese restaurant group, has closed five outlets in Singapore in 2026. The two latest closures are at Clementi Mall and Jurong Point. The company says the closures are part of a review of its operations.
items.summary_ko: 가정식 중국 레스토랑 그룹 크리스탈 제이드가 올해 싱가포르에서 매장 다섯 곳을 문 닫았습니다. 가장 최근에는 클레멘티 몰과 주롱 포인트 지점이 문을 닫았습니다. 회사는 운영 재검토의 일환으로 매장을 정리하고 있다고 밝혔습니다.
items.title_en: Crystal Jade closes 2 more Singapore restaurants in 2026

items.title_original: Crystal Jade has now closed 5 Singapore outlets in 2026, with Clementi Mall and Jurong Point the latest

items.raw_excerpt: Some Wānaka residents are appalled an off-licence has been granted for a new bottle store next door to a Plunket clinic, which has also been used as an Alcoholics Anonymous meeting space for 30 years.
items.summary_en: Residents in Wānaka are upset that a new bottle store was allowed next to a Plunket family clinic. The clinic building has hosted Alcoholics Anonymous meetings for 30 years. The committee backed the shop despite the concerns.
items.summary_ko: 와나카 주민들은 가족 클리닉 바로 옆에 새 주류 판매점이 허가된 것에 당황했다. 그 클리닉 건물은 30년 동안 알코올중독자 익명 모임의 공간으로 쓰여 왔다. 그럼에도 위원회는 우려에도 불구하고 주류 판매점을 승인했다.
items.title_en: Liquor store approved next to family clinic and AA rooms
items.title_ko: 와나카 주류 판매점, 30년째 모임 쓰는 가족 클리닉 옆에 승인 논란
items.title_original: Committee backs Wānaka bottle store next to Plunket clinic, AA meetings, despite concerns

items.raw_excerpt: A group tackling wilding pines in Central Otago says unchecked infestations in remote areas are "horrendous", highlighting the need for stronger accountability for their spread.
items.summary_en: Wilding pines spread quickly and hurt native land in Central Otago, New Zealand. Volunteers say unchecked trees in remote areas are very bad. They want the owners responsible for the spread to help pay for cleanup.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 센트럴 오타고에서는 야생 소나무가 빠르게 퍼져 자연 생태계를 해치고 있습니다. 자원봉사자들은 외딴 지역에서 통제되지 않는 소나무가 매우 심각한 상태라며 우려하고 있습니다. 이들은 확산의 책임이 있는 소유자들이 정리 비용을 부담해야 한다고 주장하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: People want wilding pine tree owners in South Island hotspots to pay for spreading trees
items.title_ko: 남섬 핫스팟의 야생 소나무 확산 책임자들에 처리 비용을 부담하라는 목소리
items.title_original: Call for legacy wilding pine forest owners in South Island hotspot to pay for spread

items.raw_excerpt: Routine traffic congestion in the Varthur, Gunjur and Balagere areas of east Bengaluru escalated on Thursday, leaving schoolchildren reportedly stuck in buses for over two hours even on routes as short as 5 km.
items.summary_en: Routine traffic congestion in eastern Bengaluru worsened on Thursday. Schoolchildren were stuck on buses for over two hours, even on routes as short as 5 km.

items.raw_excerpt: A family is buzzing after a woman stumbled upon moa bones during her daily beach walk south of Timaru.
items.summary_en: A woman found moa bones while walking on a beach south of Timaru. Her family is excited about the discovery. The bones are rare and were found during a daily walk.

items.summary_en: A celebrity's family bakery is offering special mooncakes for the Mid-Autumn Festival. The treats include mooncake croissants and gelato with a dry ice show. There is something for traditionalists and adventurous eaters alike.

items.raw_excerpt: Waiheke Island's only respite care house for kids with disabilities will be sold on the open market, ending a crucial 30-year service.
items.summary_en: The only respite care house for children with disabilities on Waiheke Island will be sold on the open market. The sale ends a crucial service that has run for 30 years. Local families will lose this support.

items.raw_excerpt: Karnataka's Tourism Department is enhancing regulations for homestays to ensure safety and combat unauthorised establishments amid rising tourist interest.
items.summary_en: Karnataka's tourism department is making new rules for homestays. The rules aim to keep guests safe and stop unlicensed places. More tourists are staying in homestays now.
items.summary_ko: 카르나타카 관광청이 홈스테이에 대한 새 규정을 만듭니다. 목표는 여행객의 안전을 지키고 무허가 숙소를 없애는 것입니다. 요즘 더 많은 여행객이 홈스테이를 이용하고 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: A Shanghai woman looking for the American teacher who tutored her free of charge two decades ago has found hundreds of his former students, but not him.
items.summary_en: A Shanghai woman is looking for the American teacher who taught her for free two decades ago. Hundreds of his former students have joined the search. They have found many of his students, but not the teacher yet.

items.raw_excerpt: A long-running pay dispute between Queensland Rail and seven unions has ended with an agreement, following months of delays for commuters.
items.summary_en: Queensland Rail ended its long pay dispute with seven unions. Workers agreed on a new deal, so trains will return to normal soon. Commuters can expect fewer delays.

items.raw_excerpt: Derbyshire County Council shut off a gap, which had been used by a family since 1967.
items.summary_en: An 81-year-old woman in Derbyshire was blocked by a fenced-off gap. The family had used that gap since 1967. After three years of fighting, she won the right to use it again.

items.summary_en: Queen Suthida wore five different outfits for her recent state visit to Vietnam. Each outfit showed traditional Thai culture and craftsmanship. The clothes highlighted fine Thai weaving and handmade skill.
